drhp.business: Vaswani Industries Limited manufactures sponge iron and steel billets through its Iron & Steel Division (Sponge Iron and Billet Divisions) at its Raipur, Chhattisgarh plant. The Company also operates a Power Division comprising Waste Heat Recovery (WHR), Atmospheric Fluidized Bed Combustion (AFBC) and solar power generation that supports its steel-making operations and energy-cost optimisation.
drhp.end_markets: Domestic Indian steel market (infrastructure, construction, automotive, engineering, renewable-energy sectors)
drhp.expansion: The Company completed and commissioned the expansion of its Billet manufacturing capacity from 66,000 MT to 1,50,000 MT per annum in June 2025; following trial runs and receipt of Consent to Operate, commercial production commenced during FY26. The Billet Plant is also being upgraded to produce special-grade steel. Separately, the Company commissioned solar power projects aggregating 66.25 MWp in Chhattisgarh — 16.25 MWp at Gandai, and 13.75 MWp plus 36.25 MWp at Mohbhatta, District Bemetara — which commenced power generation from December 2025 and are presently operational. sk.overview: India is the world's second-largest crude steel producer and second-largest stainless-steel consumer/third-largest producer, with estimated installed SS capacity of 6.6-6.8 Mn tons. Stainless steel is a high-alloy, corrosion-resistant value-added steel (>10.5% chromium) used across railways, process industries, kitchenware, automotive, construction and infrastructure. Long and flat steel demand is closely tied to overall economic, industrial and consumer activity; the sector is raw-material (SS scrap, nickel, chromium) and energy intensive and prices are volatile.
